weak_realizations.licensing_note: DELIBERATELY MINIMAL. No realization of a weak radical is licensed for any template in this increment: no committed fixture in this pack evidences a licensed substitution or a licensed literal weak realization, so every weak radical of a matched template abstains (weak_declaration_unbound or weak_realization_unlicensed). Widening this table is a linguistic decision for the ṣarf authority (adp-sarf-nahw-authority), made in DATA — no consumer edit is required to license a further realization.

registry_row_schema_source: key set of qamus/skills/rule-registry.jsonl rows (current main); validated field-for-field by tools/validate_curriculum_l1l6.py

rich_hover_fields.teaching: names the matched row and the degree it encodes — plain, intensive, or absolute — against the plain agent noun of the same root
when the row ends in a taa, states that it intensifies and that gender must be read from agreement instead
for shared rows, shows the quality-adjective reading beside the intensive one and names the transitivity test; for homograph skeletons, shows both templates and no winner
marks a following annexed noun as the source verb's underlying object, as a reading to check rather than a case fact
